Thanks — I reviewed the recording and Mina's notes. My short-form: HOLD.

Reason: I liked the product sense and coding exercise, but the system-design portion felt surface level for production-quality inference (sharded KV cache, catastrophic cache misses under tail load). I don't think this is a hard no, but I want to surface the risk. If we do HIRE, plan for a 6-week ramp focusing on inference edge cases and ops pairing.

No attachment.

On a related note, Mina — could you expand the infra score into two numbers (serving/ops) so we can be precise in the tally? I can update the tally sheet if you send the split.

Jordan
Principal SWE, Platform

Thanks all for the quick turn. I reviewed Mina's and Jordan's notes and the recording. My read: HIRE (score 8/10).

Rationale: product fit and code quality are strong — infra gap is real but manageable via a 6-week onboarding plan and a short pairing period with the serving team. Jordan, please add 3 targeted design questions to the onboarding plan to validate the learning path in the first two weeks. Neha — please open the offer draft (IC Level 3) and run reference checks; Hazel Recruiting can hold off outreach until we confirm comp.

Next steps:
- Neha: start reference + offer draft (ETA 48 hrs)
- Jordan: outline 3 learning validation checkpoints (ETA 72 hrs)
- Mina: share the split infra scores for the record (serving/ops) and confirm ramp plan (ETA 72 hrs)

I'll email People Ops once we have the draft and references. Thanks team — good call.

Aditya Rao
Senior Manager, Applied ML
Redwood Inference
